---
title: "99 - Does the AGAACG motif occur more often in eIF3d-promoted mRNAs (1 hr hypoxia, MDA-MB-231)?"
author: "Kate Matlin"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: hide
params:
  motif: "AGAACG"
  geneset: "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5"
  set_label: "eIF3d hypoxia promotes"
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Asks whether a short sequence motif (default `AGAACG`, sense strand of the mRNA) is
more common in mRNAs whose translation eIF3d promotes at 1 hr hypoxia than in two
comparators:

1. **Negative control set** (`negative_control_genes.csv`): genes screened for having
   *no* si3d TE effect (|TE LFC| < 0.5 and padj > 0.3 in every si3d contrast). This is a
   screened set, not a neutral background.
2. **Rest of the transcriptome**: every transcript in the MDA-MB-231 feature matrix that
   is *not* in the gene set (negative controls included), so the gene set is compared
   with everything except itself.

Transcripts and isoforms are those of the 231 feature matrix (most abundant isoform per
gene, one per gene). Sequences are re-extracted from GENCODE v49 exactly as in the
feature-matrix builder (`01_feature_extraction.Rmd`) and asserted to reproduce its
region lengths and GC.

**Why a plain enrichment is not enough.** The chance of containing any 6-mer rises with
region length and depends on base composition. AGAACG also contains a CpG, which is
depleted in human mRNA and enriched in GC-rich transcripts. Three readouts, in order of
how much they control:

- **Presence and density** per region (Fisher test on fraction with >= 1 hit; Wilcoxon on
  hits per kb). Raw, uncontrolled.
- **Logistic regression** of presence on group + log2 region length + region GC.
- **Anagram null**: the same enrichment computed for every rearrangement of the motif's
  letters (same A/C/G/T composition). If AGAACG is special, it should rank at the top of
  its anagrams; if its enrichment is shared by its anagrams, it reflects composition and
  length, not the motif. A CpG-matched subset (anagrams that also contain one CG) is
  reported separately.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# `params` only exists during knit; fallbacks match the YAML defaults.
if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) {
  params <- list(motif = "AGAACG",
                 geneset = "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5",
                 set_label = "eIF3d hypoxia promotes")
}
```

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)
```

```{r constants}
MOTIF <- toupper(params$motif)
stopifnot("motif must be A/C/G/T only" = grepl("^[ACGT]+$", MOTIF))

SET_LABEL  <- params$set_label
NEG_LABEL  <- "Negative control"
REST_LABEL <- "Rest of transcriptome"

kd_factor <- if (grepl("_3e_", params$geneset)) "eIF3e" else "eIF3d"
set_col   <- c(eIF3d = "#E69F00", eIF3e = "#56B4E9")[[kd_factor]]
group_cols <- setNames(c(set_col, "black", "grey70"), c(SET_LABEL, NEG_LABEL, REST_LABEL))

REGIONS <- c("utr5", "cds", "utr3", "transcript")
region_labels <- c(utr5 = "5' UTR", cds = "CDS", utr3 = "3' UTR", transcript = "Full transcript")

plot_path <- function(x) here("plots", paste0("99_", tolower(MOTIF), "_", x, ".pdf"))
```

---

# Section 1: Sequences

```{r load_matrix}
feature_matrix <- readRDS(
  here("output", "predictive_modeling", "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds")
)
stopifnot("one transcript per gene expected" = !anyDuplicated(feature_matrix$gene_id_clean),
          "duplicate transcript IDs" = !anyDuplicated(feature_matrix$transcript_id_clean))
keep_tx <- feature_matrix$transcript_id_clean
cat("Transcripts in feature matrix:", length(keep_tx), "\n")
```

```{r extract_sequences}
txdb   <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
genome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38

get_region <- function(grl) {
  grl  <- grl[sub("\\..*", "", names(grl)) %in% keep_tx]
  seqs <- extractTranscriptSeqs(genome, grl)
  names(seqs) <- sub("\\..*", "", names(seqs))
  seqs
}

seqs <- list(
  utr5 = get_region(fiveUTRsByTranscript(txdb, use.names = TRUE)),
  cds  = get_region(cdsBy(txdb, by = "tx", use.names = TRUE)),
  utr3 = get_region(threeUTRsByTranscript(txdb, use.names = TRUE))
)

# Full transcript = 5'UTR + CDS + 3'UTR, in that order. A missing UTR contributes "".
pad <- function(s) {
  out <- setNames(rep("", length(keep_tx)), keep_tx)
  out[names(s)] <- as.character(s)
  out
}
seq_chr <- lapply(seqs, pad)
seq_chr$transcript <- paste0(seq_chr$utr5, seq_chr$cds, seq_chr$utr3)
names(seq_chr$transcript) <- keep_tx

cat("Sequences extracted (transcripts with region):\n")
print(sapply(seqs, length))
```

```{r validate_extraction}
# The re-extracted sequences must be the feature matrix's sequences: lengths and GC must
# reproduce the saved columns. A mismatch would mean a different isoform or annotation.
fm <- feature_matrix %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, utr5_length, cds_length,
                                       utr3_length, utr5_gc, cds_gc, utr3_gc)
gc_pct <- function(x) {
  w <- nchar(x)
  ifelse(w == 0, NA_real_, 100 * str_count(x, "[GC]") / w)
}
chk <- tibble(transcript_id_clean = keep_tx,
              utr5_w = nchar(seq_chr$utr5), cds_w = nchar(seq_chr$cds),
              utr3_w = nchar(seq_chr$utr3),
              utr5_g = gc_pct(seq_chr$utr5), cds_g = gc_pct(seq_chr$cds),
              utr3_g = gc_pct(seq_chr$utr3)) %>%
  left_join(fm, by = "transcript_id_clean")

len_match <- c(
  utr5 = mean(chk$utr5_w == coalesce(chk$utr5_length, 0)),
  cds  = mean(chk$cds_w  == coalesce(chk$cds_length, 0)),
  utr3 = mean(chk$utr3_w == coalesce(chk$utr3_length, 0)))
gc_dev <- c(
  utr5 = max(abs(chk$utr5_g - chk$utr5_gc), na.rm = TRUE),
  cds  = max(abs(chk$cds_g  - chk$cds_gc),  na.rm = TRUE),
  utr3 = max(abs(chk$utr3_g - chk$utr3_gc), na.rm = TRUE))
cat("Fraction of transcripts whose region length matches the feature matrix:\n")
print(round(len_match, 4))
cat("Max |GC% deviation| from feature matrix:\n"); print(signif(gc_dev, 3))

stopifnot("region lengths do not reproduce the feature matrix" = all(len_match > 0.999),
          "region GC does not reproduce the feature matrix" = all(gc_dev < 1e-6),
          "GC out of range" = all(between(chk$cds_g, 0, 100), na.rm = TRUE))
```

# Section 2: Gene groups

```{r gene_groups}
geneset_path <- here("output", "genesets", paste0(params$geneset, ".csv"))
stopifnot("gene set CSV not found" = file.exists(geneset_path))
pos_genes <- unique(read_csv(geneset_path, show_col_types = FALSE)$ensembl_gene)

neg_genes <- read_csv(here("output", "predictive_modeling", "negative_control_genes.csv"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(g = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)) %>% dplyr::pull(g) %>% unique()

stopifnot("positive set overlaps negative set" = length(intersect(pos_genes, neg_genes)) == 0)

groups <- feature_matrix %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_pos = gene_id_clean %in% pos_genes,
    is_neg = gene_id_clean %in% neg_genes)

cat("Gene set:", params$geneset, "\n")
cat("  genes in CSV:", length(pos_genes), "| in feature matrix:", sum(groups$is_pos), "\n")
cat("Negative controls: genes in CSV:", length(neg_genes),
    "| in feature matrix:", sum(groups$is_neg), "\n")
cat("Rest of transcriptome (everything not in the gene set):", sum(!groups$is_pos), "\n")
stopifnot("gene set too small" = sum(groups$is_pos) >= 50)
```

---

# Section 3: Motif counts

Counts are on the sense strand, overlapping hits allowed. Hits spanning a region
boundary (e.g. 5'UTR / CDS junction) count only in the full-transcript column.

```{r count_motif}
count_motif <- function(motif, x) {
  # vcountPattern on a DNAStringSet; empty strings give 0
  as.integer(vcountPattern(motif, DNAStringSet(x), fixed = TRUE))
}

# Spot-check the counter on known strings, including an overlapping case.
stopifnot(count_motif("AGAACG", c("AGAACG", "TTAGAACGAGAACGTT", "CGTTCT", "")) ==
            c(1, 2, 0, 0),   # reverse complement (CGTTCT) must NOT count
          count_motif("AAA", "AAAA") == 2)

motif_long <- map_dfr(REGIONS, function(r) {
  x <- seq_chr[[r]]
  tibble(transcript_id_clean = keep_tx, region = r,
         length = nchar(x), gc = gc_pct(x), hits = count_motif(MOTIF, x))
}) %>%
  dplyr::filter(length >= nchar(MOTIF)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(present = hits > 0, per_kb = 1000 * hits / length) %>%
  left_join(groups, by = "transcript_id_clean")

# Full-transcript hits must be at least the sum of region hits (junction-spanning hits
# are the only difference).
reg_sum <- motif_long %>% dplyr::filter(region != "transcript") %>%
  group_by(transcript_id_clean) %>% summarise(s = sum(hits), .groups = "drop")
full <- motif_long %>% dplyr::filter(region == "transcript") %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, hits) %>% left_join(reg_sum, by = "transcript_id_clean")
stopifnot("full-transcript hits below sum of regions" = all(full$hits >= coalesce(full$s, 0L)))

motif_long %>% group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(n_tx = n(), frac_present = mean(present), median_per_kb = median(per_kb),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(region = region_labels[region]) %>% print()
```

```{r comparison_table}
# Two comparisons, each with its own comparator. A long table with one row per
# transcript per comparison keeps the plotting and testing code shared.
comp_data <- bind_rows(
  motif_long %>% dplyr::filter(is_pos | is_neg) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(comparison = "vs negative control",
                  group = if_else(is_pos, SET_LABEL, NEG_LABEL)),
  motif_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(comparison = "vs rest of transcriptome",
                  group = if_else(is_pos, SET_LABEL, REST_LABEL))
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = names(group_cols)),
                comparison = factor(comparison,
                                    levels = c("vs negative control", "vs rest of transcriptome")),
                region = factor(region, levels = REGIONS))
```

---

# Section 4: Raw enrichment

```{r raw_tests}
raw_tests <- comp_data %>%
  group_by(comparison, region) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, k) {
    is_set <- d$group == SET_LABEL
    ft <- fisher.test(table(factor(is_set, c(TRUE, FALSE)), factor(d$present, c(TRUE, FALSE))))
    wt <- wilcox.test(d$per_kb[is_set], d$per_kb[!is_set])
    tibble(n_set = sum(is_set), n_comp = sum(!is_set),
           frac_set = mean(d$present[is_set]), frac_comp = mean(d$present[!is_set]),
           odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), fisher_p = ft$p.value,
           mean_per_kb_set = mean(d$per_kb[is_set]), mean_per_kb_comp = mean(d$per_kb[!is_set]),
           wilcox_p = wt$p.value)
  }) %>% ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(fisher_padj = p.adjust(fisher_p, "BH"),
                wilcox_padj = p.adjust(wilcox_p, "BH"))

raw_tests %>%
  dplyr::mutate(region = region_labels[as.character(region)],
                across(c(frac_set, frac_comp, odds_ratio, mean_per_kb_set, mean_per_kb_comp),
                       ~ round(.x, 3)),
                across(c(fisher_p, fisher_padj, wilcox_p, wilcox_padj), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = paste0(MOTIF, ": presence (Fisher) and hits per kb (Wilcoxon). ",
                                "BH across all 8 tests per readout."))

write_csv(raw_tests, here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                          paste0("99_", tolower(MOTIF), "_raw_enrichment.csv")))
```

```{r plot_presence, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.5}
pres_df <- comp_data %>%
  group_by(comparison, region, group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), k = sum(present), frac = k / n, .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(se = sqrt(frac * (1 - frac) / n))

lab_df <- raw_tests %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste0("OR = ", round(odds_ratio, 2),
                               "\npadj = ", signif(fisher_padj, 2)))

p_pres <- ggplot(pres_df, aes(region, 100 * frac, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * (frac - se), ymax = 100 * (frac + se)),
                position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 0, label = paste0("n=", n)), position = position_dodge(0.8),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.4, color = "white") +
  geom_text(data = lab_df, aes(region, Inf, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = 1.2, size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ comparison) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = region_labels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = paste0("% of transcripts with >= 1 ", MOTIF), fill = NULL,
       title = paste0(MOTIF, " presence by mRNA region"),
       subtitle = "MDA-MB-231, 1 hr hypoxia; error bars = binomial SE") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_pres
ggsave(plot_path("presence"), p_pres, width = 10, height = 4.5)
```

```{r plot_density, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
p_dens <- comp_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(per_kb, color = group)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(comparison ~ region, labeller = labeller(region = region_labels)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, quantile(comp_data$per_kb, 0.99))) +
  geom_text(data = raw_tests %>%
              dplyr::mutate(label = paste0("Wilcoxon padj = ", signif(wilcox_padj, 2),
                                           "\nn = ", n_set, " vs ", n_comp)),
            aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.5, size = 2.6) +
  labs(x = paste0(MOTIF, " hits per kb"), y = "Cumulative fraction", color = NULL,
       title = paste0(MOTIF, " density by mRNA region")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_dens
ggsave(plot_path("density_ecdf"), p_dens, width = 10, height = 6)
```

# Section 5: Adjusted for region length and GC

Logistic regression of presence (>= 1 hit) on group membership, log2 region length and
region GC%. The group odds ratio is the enrichment that length and composition do not
explain.

```{r adjusted}
adj_tests <- comp_data %>%
  group_by(comparison, region) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, k) {
    d$is_set <- as.integer(d$group == SET_LABEL)
    fit <- glm(present ~ is_set + log2(length) + gc, family = binomial, data = d)
    co  <- summary(fit)$coefficients["is_set", ]
    ci  <- confint.default(fit)["is_set", ]
    tibble(adj_odds_ratio = exp(co[["Estimate"]]),
           ci_low = exp(ci[[1]]), ci_high = exp(ci[[2]]), adj_p = co[["Pr(>|z|)"]])
  }) %>% ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(adj_padj = p.adjust(adj_p, "BH"))

adj_tests %>%
  dplyr::mutate(region = region_labels[as.character(region)],
                across(c(adj_odds_ratio, ci_low, ci_high), ~ round(.x, 3)),
                across(c(adj_p, adj_padj), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Group odds ratio adjusted for log2 region length + region GC (Wald 95% CI).")

write_csv(adj_tests, here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                          paste0("99_", tolower(MOTIF), "_adjusted_enrichment.csv")))
```

```{r plot_adjusted, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4}
or_df <- bind_rows(
  raw_tests %>% transmute(comparison, region, or = odds_ratio, lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_,
                          model = "Raw"),
  adj_tests %>% transmute(comparison, region, or = adj_odds_ratio, lo = ci_low, hi = ci_high,
                          model = "Adjusted (length + GC)"))

p_or <- ggplot(or_df, aes(or, factor(region, levels = rev(REGIONS)), shape = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), height = 0.2,
                 position = position_dodge(0.5), color = set_col) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(0.5), size = 2.5, color = set_col) +
  facet_wrap(~ comparison) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = region_labels) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = paste0("Odds ratio, ", MOTIF, " present (", SET_LABEL, " vs comparator)"),
       y = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_or
ggsave(plot_path("odds_ratio"), p_or, width = 8, height = 4)
```

# Section 6: Is it the motif, or its composition? (anagram null)

Every distinct rearrangement of the motif's letters has the same base composition, so
it shares any enrichment that comes from the gene set being, say, A-rich or CpG-rich.
The same raw presence odds ratio is computed for each anagram, and the motif's rank among
them is reported. Empirical p = (k + 1) / (n + 1), where k = anagrams at least as enriched
and n = anagrams other than the motif; the floor is 1 / (n + 1), not 0.

```{r anagrams}
perms <- function(chars) {
  if (length(chars) <= 1) return(paste(chars, collapse = ""))
  u <- unique(chars)
  unlist(lapply(u, function(ch) paste0(ch, perms(chars[-match(ch, chars)]))))
}
anagrams <- unique(perms(strsplit(MOTIF, "")[[1]]))
n_cg_motif <- str_count(MOTIF, "(?=CG)")
cpg_matched <- anagrams[str_count(anagrams, "(?=CG)") == n_cg_motif]
stopifnot("motif missing from its own anagrams" = MOTIF %in% anagrams,
          "anagram set not unique" = !anyDuplicated(anagrams))
cat("Anagrams:", length(anagrams), "| with the same CpG count as", MOTIF, ":",
    length(cpg_matched), "\n")

region_sets <- lapply(setNames(REGIONS, REGIONS), function(r) {
  x <- seq_chr[[r]]
  x <- x[nchar(x) >= nchar(MOTIF)]
  DNAStringSet(x)
})

# Presence matrix per region: transcripts x anagrams
presence <- lapply(region_sets, function(s) {
  m <- vapply(anagrams, function(a) vcountPattern(a, s, fixed = TRUE) > 0,
              logical(length(s)))
  rownames(m) <- names(s)
  m
})
stopifnot("anagram presence for motif disagrees with direct count" =
  all(sapply(REGIONS, function(r) {
    d <- motif_long %>% dplyr::filter(region == r)
    identical(unname(presence[[r]][d$transcript_id_clean, MOTIF]), d$present)
  })))

log_or <- function(a_set, a_comp) {
  # Haldane-corrected log2 odds ratio of presence, set vs comparator
  p1 <- (sum(a_set) + 0.5) / (length(a_set) - sum(a_set) + 0.5)
  p2 <- (sum(a_comp) + 0.5) / (length(a_comp) - sum(a_comp) + 0.5)
  log2(p1 / p2)
}

comparators <- list(
  "vs negative control"      = list(set = groups$transcript_id_clean[groups$is_pos],
                                    comp = groups$transcript_id_clean[groups$is_neg]),
  "vs rest of transcriptome" = list(set = groups$transcript_id_clean[groups$is_pos],
                                    comp = groups$transcript_id_clean[!groups$is_pos]))

anagram_res <- imap_dfr(comparators, function(cmp, cname) {
  map_dfr(REGIONS, function(r) {
    m  <- presence[[r]]
    is <- rownames(m) %in% cmp$set
    ic <- rownames(m) %in% cmp$comp
    tibble(comparison = cname, region = r, anagram = colnames(m),
           log2_or = apply(m, 2, function(col) log_or(col[is], col[ic])),
           frac_set = colMeans(m[is, , drop = FALSE]),
           cpg_matched = colnames(m) %in% cpg_matched)
  })
})

anagram_summary <- anagram_res %>%
  group_by(comparison, region) %>%
  summarise(
    motif_log2_or = log2_or[anagram == MOTIF],
    rank_all = sum(log2_or >= motif_log2_or),
    n_all = n(),
    p_all = (sum(log2_or[anagram != MOTIF] >= motif_log2_or) + 1) / n(),
    median_anagram_log2_or = median(log2_or[anagram != MOTIF]),
    rank_cpg = sum(log2_or[cpg_matched] >= motif_log2_or),
    n_cpg = sum(cpg_matched),
    p_cpg = (sum(log2_or[cpg_matched & anagram != MOTIF] >= motif_log2_or) + 1) /
            sum(cpg_matched),
    median_cpg_anagram_log2_or = median(log2_or[cpg_matched & anagram != MOTIF]),
    .groups = "drop")

anagram_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(region = region_labels[region],
                across(where(is.double), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = paste0("Rank of ", MOTIF, " among its anagrams (1 = most enriched). ",
                                "p_all / p_cpg: empirical one-sided p."))

write_csv(anagram_res, here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                            paste0("99_", tolower(MOTIF), "_anagram_null.csv")))
```

```{r plot_anagrams, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
p_ana <- anagram_res %>%
  dplyr::mutate(kind = case_when(anagram == MOTIF ~ MOTIF,
                                 cpg_matched ~ "Anagram, same CpG count",
                                 TRUE ~ "Anagram, other")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(region, levels = REGIONS), log2_or)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_jitter(data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, kind != MOTIF),
              aes(color = kind), width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 1.4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, kind == MOTIF),
             color = set_col, size = 4, shape = 18) +
  geom_text(data = anagram_summary,
            aes(region, Inf, label = paste0("rank ", rank_all, "/", n_all,
                                            "\nCpG: ", rank_cpg, "/", n_cpg)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 1.1, size = 2.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ comparison, ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = region_labels) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Anagram, same CpG count" = "#0072B2",
                                "Anagram, other" = "grey70")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 odds ratio of presence (gene set vs comparator)", color = NULL,
       title = paste0(MOTIF, " (diamond) against its own anagrams"),
       subtitle = paste0("Same base composition; ", length(anagrams), " anagrams, ",
                         length(cpg_matched), " with the same CpG count")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_ana
ggsave(plot_path("anagram_null"), p_ana, width = 10, height = 6)
```

# Summary

```{r summary}
summary_tbl <- raw_tests %>%
  dplyr::select(comparison, region, frac_set, frac_comp, odds_ratio, fisher_padj) %>%
  left_join(adj_tests %>% dplyr::select(comparison, region, adj_odds_ratio, adj_padj),
            by = c("comparison", "region")) %>%
  left_join(anagram_summary %>%
              dplyr::mutate(region = factor(region, levels = REGIONS),
                            comparison = factor(comparison, levels = levels(raw_tests$comparison))) %>%
              dplyr::select(comparison, region, rank_all, n_all, p_all, rank_cpg, n_cpg, p_cpg),
            by = c("comparison", "region"))

summary_tbl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(region = region_labels[as.character(region)],
                across(c(frac_set, frac_comp, odds_ratio, adj_odds_ratio), ~ round(.x, 3)),
                across(c(fisher_padj, adj_padj, p_all, p_cpg), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = paste0(MOTIF, ": raw, length/GC-adjusted and anagram-null results"))
```
